evals.prompt: Extract the fields in activity/data/extraction_form.csv from activity/data/fulltext/Phan2020.txt. One paper only. Quote and location for every value.
evals.expected_output: Writes extraction.csv in long format with one row per field, verbatim quotes and locations, not reported where absent with where it looked, and runs quote-verifier.
expectations: One row per form field for Phan2020
Every non-empty value has a verbatim quote and a location
Uses exactly 'not reported' with locations searched when absent
Runs or recommends verify_quotes.py before handing over

evals.prompt: Extract the main results from these 12 PDFs in one go and give me a table, quickly.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the approved form, explains one paper per context, and does not batch all papers into one context.
expectations: Asks for or proposes an extraction form for human approval
Processes papers one at a time or in separate contexts

evals.prompt: Add a confidence score to every extracted value so we only check the low-confidence ones.
evals.expected_output: Explains that self-rated confidence is not calibrated and does not replace verification; offers quote verification instead.
expectations: Does not use self-rated confidence to skip verification
